                  <milestone n="a. lo tsha ba" unit="section"/>dang po ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">rngog</rs> na re spyir gzhi shes kyi mshan nyid ni gzhi tsam shes pa yin la laM shes kyi mtshan nyid ni laM tsam shes pa yin la rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid rnam pa'i chos rnaMs skye ba med par mngon suM du shes pa yin pas na | sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar la gzhi shes yod la | brgyad pa dgu pa bcu pa 
               <lb edRef="inst:5176" n="17a3"/> gsum la gnyen po gzhi shes dang laM shes 2 res res 'jog du skye la res dus mnyam du sbrul 'go rdengs ka ltar skye la | b+hu ta'i sa na mkhyen pa 3 sbrul 'go'i rde sa ga ltar ngo bo tha dad du yod pa'o zer ro ||</seg></TEI>
